description: Main source file for WiFi SSP component, handling configuration, signal handling, thread creation, and system initialization.

methods.name: getSyscfgLogLevel
methods.description: Thread function to initialize syscfg and retrieve log level settings, possibly from remote ARM IP.

methods.name: cmd_dispatch
methods.description: Handles command inputs for starting/stopping WiFi agent, retrieving parameters, and printing memory tables.

methods.name: _print_stack_backtrace
methods.description: Prints the current call stack for debugging.

methods.name: sig_handler
methods.description: Handles various UNIX signals for cleanup, backtrace, and logging.

methods.name: drop_root
methods.description: Drops root privileges if configured to do so, based on syscfg setting.

methods.name: lnf_ssid_updateBootLogTime
methods.description: Updates boot log with the uptime of the LnF SSID if enabled.

methods.name: ssp_main
methods.description: Main entry point for WiFi SSP, handles configuration, signal setup, and main loop.

methods.name: ssp_func
methods.description: Thread wrapper that calls ssp_main with predefined arguments.

methods.name: start_dml_main
methods.description: Starts the SSP thread and initializes WFA schema parsing.
